title: Choose the Move to Cross the Chasm
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Choose, for six situations, the move that best helps an innovation cross the chasm from early adopters to the early majority.

educational.topic: Choose the Move to Cross the Chasm
learningObjectives: The learner will apply Moore's chasm ideas by choosing, for each of six situations, the move that best helps an innovation cross from early adopters to the early majority, correctly choosing at least five of six on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The chasm, pragmatist buyers, crossing the chasm, the beachhead strategy, the whole product, and opinion leaders, from the sections "Adopter Categories and the Adoption Curve" and "The Chasm" in Chapter 15.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: A district gave a little support to all 40 schools at once and none has a visible success. Which move?
Teachers say the tool has no training and does not connect to their login. Which move?
commonMisconceptions: Spreading effort across every group is safer than focusing
Enthusiasm from innovators proves the product is ready for everyone
assessmentOpportunities: A district gave a little support to all 40 schools at once and none has a visible success. Which move?
Teachers say the tool has no training and does not connect to their login. Which move?
A skeptical teacher asks, "Has anyone like me made this work?" Which move?

controls.name: 4 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the moves; two tries per situation.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Opens a table of the moves and their meanings.
